'''Trahg''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Descent" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> who served as a [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the [[Imperial Guard]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A fair-skinned Human with [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], blond [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and a small striped beard, Trahg wore the crimson [[Armor/Legends|armor]] of a Guardsman and carried an [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]].<ref name="Descent" /> In [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> Trahg was stationed aboard the [[Emperor's Fortress|personal space station]] of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] when the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] was [[Mission to the Emperor's Fortress|boarded]] by a [[Jedi strike team (capture of the Sith Emperor)|strike team]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with the purpose of capturing the Emperor. Trahg and their men attempted to defeat two members of the strike team, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] and the Hero's former [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Kira Carsen]], but he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the fighting.<ref name="Descent" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trahg first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], as a named enemy NPC during the Jedi Knight class mission "Descent."<ref name="Descent" />
